claims.title: Exact rational finite-horizon TV path polytope
claims.scope: finite categorical source laws with exact rational initial law, finite horizon, and a uniform total-variation step bound
assumptions: q_0 is fixed and every future law is a probability vector on the same finite alphabet
TV(q_t,q_{t-1}) is bounded by the declared rational eta
active-basis enumeration completes below the configured cap
nonclaims: bounded active-basis enumeration is not a polynomial-time scalability theorem
the path set is not a statistical confidence region without a separate calibration argument

claims.title: Exact primal-dual coupled drift cost certificate
claims.scope: finite time-varying rational state-cost vectors optimized over the declared bounded-TV path polytope
assumptions: the path objective is linear in each period law
both primal vertex and dual support enumeration complete below their caps
nonclaims: the dual multipliers certify the internal finite model rather than parent-substrate resources
the theorem does not cover nonlinear path objectives without a separate reduction

claims.title: Periodwise marginal TV extrema can strictly overstate a coupled path adversary
claims.scope: finite-horizon time-varying linear costs under a common initial law and bounded TV transitions
assumptions: the marginal relaxation uses only TV(q_t,p)<=min(t eta,1)
the exact path retains every adjacent transition constraint
nonclaims: the relaxation is exact for a fixed repeated cost vector under the nested transport assumptions
one strict example does not quantify the maximum possible gap for all dimensions and horizons

claims.title: Exact bounded precommitted code-sequence optimization with switching costs
claims.scope: a complete bounded deterministic zero-error prefix-code universe, an open-loop finite codebook sequence, bounded TV source drift, and rational per-switch cost
assumptions: the whole codebook sequence is chosen before and visible to the source-law adversary
the switch penalty depends only on adjacent codebook identity changes
code, path, and sequence enumerations complete below configured caps
nonclaims: no feedback-adaptive or learned code policy is optimized
the rational switching penalty is a design input rather than an inferred physical cost

claims.title: K3 rotating short-word code has an exact one-sixth reconfiguration threshold
claims.scope: complete three-state confusion graph, uniform initial law, eta=1/6, two periods, and binary zero-error prefix codes
assumptions: the nondominated code vectors are the permutations of (1,2,2)
ties are resolved in favor of fewer switches
nonclaims: the one-sixth threshold is specific to the declared K3 instance
temporal diversification is open-loop and is not evidence of source learning

claims.title: Bounded exact coupled-drift and code-sequence audit
claims.scope: the finite rational path, dual, code-universe, and sequence instances exercised by the repository test suite
assumptions: all configured enumeration caps complete without truncation
Python Fraction arithmetic is used for all finite objective and feasibility calculations
nonclaims: CI success is not a scalability theorem
finite internal coding checks are not evidence that reality is simulated
